question: Who were awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry?
answer: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, announced on October 7, 2026 [2][3]. The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences honored them "for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis" [3]. Kagan is at Paris-Saclay University and Soai at the Tokyo University of Science, according to C&EN [2]. The Hindu describes both as professors emeritus, at the former Université Paris-Sud and the Tokyo University of Science respectively [4]. They share the 12 million Swedish kronor prize [2][4]. Kagan's work allowed a greater excess of one mirror-image form to be created than was previously thought possible [3]. Soai designed the first reaction in which only one of the potential mirror images was formed [3].
